Colombia Opens Jerusalem Embassy, Restores Trade with Israel

Colombia has opened an embassy in Jerusalem and restored free trade with Israel. The move was hailed by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who stated, 'The global woke coalition just went down.' The inauguration ceremony took place on Wednesday, following the inauguration of Colombia's hard-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, in August, who had pledged to move the embassy.
